lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso with tighter density near the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior lines 1 and 2 terminate at the mid-flank; posterior lines 11, 12, and 13 are abbreviated and transition into fragmented spots toward the rump.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Approximately 8 high-contrast white spots clustered on the lateral surface of the posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal sequence of 3 distinct spots is visible on the lower haunch, forming a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white patch on the lower throat; distinct white spot on the cheek; white bands present on the lower forelimbs and hindlimbs.
